items.stem: Which of the following is one of the benefits of training to the organisation?
items.answer: Equips the future manager
items.markingKey: (b) "Equips the future manager" is one of the benefits of training to the organisation; the others are benefits of training to the employee.

items.stem: After proper selection, Singh and Sons placed each person in a job that matched their skills, and output rose. Which point of importance of staffing is highlighted?
items.answer: Higher performance
items.markingKey: (b) Higher performance. The right person in the right job.
